subject: Physics
axis_note: ladder_position is a curriculum coordinate, never a learner estimate; teaching depth is intrinsic while practice support is routed separately.

must_contain: Two vectors expressed in one declared axis system with at least one negative component.
The resultant obtained by adding corresponding signed components, with a geometric direction check.

controlled_variation.vary: one input component sign while keeping the other components fixed
controlled_variation.hold: the axis convention and all other component values
controlled_variation.notice: the corresponding resultant component changes by that signed amount

controlled_variation.vary: the order of the two addends
controlled_variation.hold: the same vectors and axis convention
controlled_variation.notice: the resultant is unchanged, exposing commutativity of vector addition

must_contain: A stated target for one resultant component, including a zero-component case.
At least two signed input contributions on the constrained axis so one can compensate the other.

controlled_variation.hold: the zero target on the resultant axis
controlled_variation.notice: the required compensating component changes to the equal opposite signed value

controlled_variation.vary: the target resultant component from zero to a nonzero value
controlled_variation.notice: the required input follows from the same signed component-sum equation rather than a special-case rule

must_contain: A second arrow reversed without rescaling before addition.
The same pair evaluated in both subtraction orders.

controlled_variation.vary: which operand is subtracted from which
controlled_variation.notice: the difference arrow reverses while its magnitude stays the same

family.invariant_demand: Use one declared axis system, preserve signed directional information, combine corresponding vector components, impose any stated resultant-component constraint, and preserve operand order for subtraction.
family.difficult_move: Keeping the physical direction requirement attached to the correct signed component equation instead of replacing vector operations with magnitude arithmetic or a story-specific shortcut.
family.independent_check: Use an alternate representation: a rough arrow construction must agree with the component signs; a constrained component must satisfy its target after substitution; swapping subtraction operands must negate the result.

support_ladder.handed_over: The axis directions, relevant component equation, and requested vector operation are supplied.
The axis directions and requested resultant condition are supplied.
Only the physical/geometric description and requested resultant are supplied.

transfer.changed_demand: Two vectors are described by a diagram or words and must first be written as signed components before they can be added.
A requested direction must be translated into a target value for one resultant component before solving for an unknown input contribution.
transfer.information_not_handed_over: which component is constrained and what target value it must take

transfer.changed_demand: The same pair of vectors is presented in the opposite subtraction order.
transfer.information_not_handed_over: the final orientation of the difference
